name: @verisource/cli
description: Local-first AI Search GEO readiness scanner, 20-page link health crawler, codebase route mapper, and deterministic browser workflow verifier.

scripts.pack:public: node scripts/bundle.mjs && node -e "const cp=require('node:child_process'),fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');const d=p.resolve('../../apps/web/public/downloads');fs.mkdirSync(d,{recursive:true});const t=cp.execSync('npm pack --quiet',{encoding:'utf8'}).trim();fs.renameSync(t,p.join(d,'verisource-cli.tgz'));console.log('✓ Packed',p.join(d,'verisource-cli.tgz'));"
